citations.case: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, category K40 (inguinal hernia codes distinguish bilateral from unilateral, with or without obstruction or gangrene, and recurrent from not specified as recurrent); ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.13 (laterality: the code names whether the condition is on the left, the right or bilateral); Section IV.F.3 (code to the highest level of specificity supported by the documentation); Section I.B.5 (signs and symptoms associated routinely with a disease process are not assigned as additional codes)

coder_notes: A reducible right inguinal hernia with no obstruction and no gangrene, and no previous repair on either side. The left groin has no hernia, so the hernia is unilateral. The inguinal hernia codes distinguish unilateral from bilateral and do not name the right or left side. The groin bulge and discomfort are symptoms of the hernia. The planned repair is not coded. Traps: the bilateral code (K40.20) because both groins are examined; the recurrent code (K40.91); a code with obstruction (K40.30) or with gangrene (K40.40)
